name: INUMI
fix_description: In setMarketingWallet (0x5d098b38), there is no msg.sender validation. Anyone can change the marketing wallet address to receive token fees. Add require(msg.sender == owner) before updating storage[0x08].
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward two-step exploit: the attacker sets a privileged wallet address and then calls a fund-withdrawal function. It matches an obvious missing access control pattern, requires no DeFi-specific knowledge, and the PoC is very short with minimal contract interaction.
